Sports and Betting Markets on Reddy Book
Cricket Betting
Cricket sits at the heart of the platform, offering full coverage of major events like the IPL, ICC tournaments, Asia Cup, and bilateral series. Users can place bets on match results, toss outcomes, player performances, total scores, and session markets. Live betting stays active throughout the game, with odds constantly adjusting ball-by-ball, especially during high-profile leagues like the IPL.
Football Betting
Football markets include top competitions such as the Premier League, La Liga, and Champions League. You can bet on match results, total goals, halftime outcomes, and in-play events. The available matches rotate based on weekly schedules, while live betting keeps things dynamic with odds updating in real time as the action unfolds.
Live Casino Games
The live casino section brings real-time gaming with professional dealers hosting tables for Roulette, Blackjack, Baccarat, Teen Patti, and Andar Bahar. These games are streamed live, creating an immersive experience similar to a physical casino. Popular Indian favorites like Teen Patti and Andar Bahar are optimized for smooth gameplay across mobile devices.
Other Sports
Beyond cricket and football, the platform supports a variety of sports. Tennis fans can explore markets across Grand Slams and ATP/WTA events, while kabaddi betting covers leagues like the Pro Kabaddi League. Virtual sports are also available around the clock, offering quick matches and continuous betting opportunities anytime.

Reddy Book – Frequently Asked Questions:
Everything you need to know how to create your account, start playing and depositing money.
How do I create and verify my Reddy Book ID?
Sign up via the official Reddy Book website or the verified app listing, provide your email/mobile and a strong password, then complete the on‑screen verification (SMS OTP or email confirmation). If withdrawals require KYC, follow the platform’s instructions to upload ID and proof of address; keep copies of confirmation messages but never share your password or OTP.
What should I check before making my first deposit?
Confirm the minimum deposit, minimum withdrawal, expected withdrawal processing time, and any KYC requirements; use only the official payment channels shown inside your account. Start with a small, test deposit so you can place one bet and then request a small withdrawal to verify the full money flow before committing larger amounts.
My withdrawal is delayed what steps should I take?
First, check your account’s transaction history and any pending‑status messages. If no automated explanation appears, open a support ticket through the in‑app/help section and provide transaction IDs and screenshots; escalate only via the platform’s published channels and keep records of all correspondence.
Is the Reddy Book app safe to install and use?
Only install the app from official sources (the Reddy Book website link, Google Play, or Apple App Store) and verify the publisher name and listing details. Avoid APKs from untrusted links, limit app permissions to what’s required, enable any offered 2FA, and never share OTPs or passwords with anyone claiming to be support.
How can I bet more responsibly and avoid chasing losses?
Set a clear budget before you start, use deposit or session limits available in the app, avoid increasing stakes after a loss, and take breaks during live matches. If betting stops being fun or you notice impulsive behavior, use the platform’s self‑exclusion or cooling‑off options and seek help from local responsible‑gambling resources.
Is Reddy Book legal for me to use in India?
Legality depends on the state you live in; online betting rules vary across Indian states and change over time.
